name: Control Breathing (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): When the ninja fails a save against a spell or effect with the emotion* descriptor, as an immediate action the ninja may make a second saving throw with a +1d6 morale bonus. If the second save is successful, the ninja is treated as having saved against the effect. On the ninja’s next turn the ninja is staggered (as part of her action has been used to focus on and control her breathing to overcome the emotional effect). The ninja must have at least 1 ki point to use this trick.
* This includes all fear effects.
